items.headline: Best-Positioned Stocks as EV and Self-Driving Tech Accelerate
items.snippet: Albemarle appears well-positioned to benefit as EV demand grows globally, with Albemarle projecting 10-20% CAGR for lithium demand from 2025 to 2030.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Let's now turn to a deeper dive into EV and stationary storage markets. Lithium demand is up 45% through May, primarily driven by continued strength in stationary storage. Lithium demand growth continues to outstrip supply growth.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry decline of 7.8% and the S&P 500's 13.9% increase. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock.

items.headline: The demand for lithium carbonate is expected to continue its growth trend, with potential for price increases.
items.snippet: In South American salt lakes, Albemarle's (ALB) capacity in Chile has been affected by strikes and is in a critical period of labor negotiation. SQM's Argentine projects Fenix Phase II and Sal de Vida are starting ahead of schedule.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in the first half of 2026 after subsidy withdrawals, yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May, above Albemarle's 15%-to-40% forecast range. Stationary storage is driving the gap.
